Definition: from G4474; a slap:--(+ strike with the) palm of the hand, smite with the hand.
BiblicalUsage: One of the officers struck Jesus with the palm of his hand for answering the high priest, the soldiers came and smote Him, and the servants did strike Him with the palms of their hands.
TheologicalSignificance: My reading of this is that the slap is the contempt of men who have no answer but their hands.
